event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hot CPI, hawkish tape, chips cracked.
Nov headline CPI printed +0.4% m/m vs 0.3% forecast and core +0.3% vs 0.2%, pushing CME FedWatch to 100% hike odds for the Dec 9 FOMC and lifting the dollar +0.62% while real yields pressured gold -2.68%. Breadth held (247/250 advancers) but leadership broke: XLK -1.15% on NVDA -5.47% at 3.1x volume — this is a high-to-low rotation under a hawkish repricing, not a broad risk-off.

INDICES — VIX 19.5, just above its 19.3 20-day MA; QQQ below its 200-day MA — a CTA sell trigger, and QQQ's -9.25% 20-day confirms the break. Ranked: RSP -0.03%, DIA -0.31%, SPY -0.37%, QQQ -0.68%. Large = small at -0.37%. Most notable cross-asset move: silver -3.45%.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Overall tape is quiet at 0.94x; SPY vol_ratio and QQQ vol_ratio both sit at 0.8x — declining volume on a down day, so no distribution, just drift. Attention went to SOXX 2.0x and XLE 0.9x (gaining), while XLP/XLI/XLU at 0.6x were ignored; NVDA's 3.1x spike on -5.47% is the day's real distribution signal. Breadth: 69% of S&P above 50-DMA, 62% above 200-DMA, up/down volume 0.64, 46 new 60-day highs vs 9 lows — participation confirms the index move broadly, diverging only at the mega-cap/AI edge.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLF Financials +0.52%, XLE Energy +0.44%, XLC Comms +0.37%, XLV Healthcare +0.29%, XLP Staples +0.15%, XLY Discretionary +0.03%, XLI Industrials -0.09%, XLRE Real Estate -0.13%, XLU Utilities -0.14%, XLB Materials -0.17%, XLK Technology -1.15%. Industries: FCG +1.61% and KIE +1.51% led; SILJ -5.73% and GDX -5.43% lagged. Flows contradict the price ranking: XLV +$626mm (94p) and XLK +$607mm (94p) drew the biggest 5-day inflows while XLC -$1,018mm (2p) and XLF -$823mm (14p) bled — leaders (financials) leaking flows means short-covering, not conviction. Money is moving into defensives/healthcare and buying the chip dip, out of comms and financials; strongest groups XLF/XLE, weakest XLK/silver miners — label: high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.73 and QQQ 0.88 signal no panic protection; QQQ skew +11.2% and ATM IV 24.7% vs SPY 14.2% show chip-specific fear. VIXEQ 44.1 vs VIX 19.5 is a wide gap — high single-stock dispersion, low implied correlation, a rotation/stock-picker tape rather than macro-correlated. MOVE reads 0.0 (unavailable), so no bond-vol read.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar +0.62% on the CPI beat is crushing metals: GLD -2.68%, SLV -3.45%, and the 10-year auction cleared 5.02% vs 5.30% prior with bid-to-cover 2.46 vs 2.77. Nat gas +3.37% (UNG) is the lone commodity bid while oil slipped -0.85%. Next FOMC is Dec 9, 2026: CME FedWatch prices 100% hike; Polymarket shows just 4% for no change (down 30pp in 5 days) and 11% for a 50bp+ move.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 57.7, Neutral. Movers: NVDA -5.47% on the Jensen Huang/Chinese-spy probe headline, PAAS -5.83% despite its $0.185 dividend declaration, LEN -5.37% with no catalyst in feed (data-only decline). VOL spikes: GXC 10.8x at -1.17% (China distribution) and SOXX 2.0x at -0.12% (absorbing flows, +$27.2bn 5-day — buy-the-dip). Watch tomorrow: GLD -2.68% into $365 gamma flip/maxpain (magnet risk), FCG +1.61% as nat-gas strength builds, and QQQ at maxpain $677 below the 200-DMA.
